deployments_detail.use: Gaia: enterprise generative-AI platform that auto-drafts clinical and regulatory documents across R&D; connects to 90+ data sources via an internal LLM router/garden, uses multi-agent systems and RAG (vectors + graphs). By end of 2024 it automated 26 document types. [AWS Bedrock (LLM access); AbbVie enterprise LLM router/garden; Accenture (implementation)]
deployments_detail.value: 20,000 hours saved annually (2024); up to 80-90% reduction in manual writing effort; target 350+ doc types / 115,000+ hours by 2030

deployments_detail.use: AbbVie R&D Convergence Hub (ARCH): ML-driven knowledge-graph analytics platform that harmonizes 200+ internal/external data sources and 2B+ scientific knowledge points to accelerate early-stage drug discovery and target identification. [Internally developed]

Machine-learning algorithm for clinical trial site selection: ranks candidate investigator sites by quantitative performance in analogous prior studies; systematized part of the site-selection process in oncology development operations for over a year. [Internally developed]
deployments_detail.value: Increased number of sites meeting enrollment and startup-time goals by more than 50%

deployments_detail.use: Generative AI and protein/chemical language models used to design novel molecules and engineer antibodies (predicting protein structures and assessing compound viability before synthesis) in drug discovery. [Internally developed]

Research collaboration with BigHat Biosciences using its AI/ML-guided Milliner platform (ML integrated with a high-speed wet lab) to discover next-generation therapeutic antibodies in oncology and neuroscience. [BigHat Biosciences (Milliner platform)]
deployments_detail.value: $30M upfront to BigHat; ~$325M potential research milestones plus commercial milestones and tiered royalties

deployments_detail.use: Deploying Claude for Life Sciences (Anthropic) across regulatory compliance, drug discovery and cancer therapy development; used to analyze multimodal biological data and optimize clinical trial design. [Anthropic (Claude for Life Sciences)]
AI/ML across R&D for drug discovery; named collaboration w/ BigHat Biosciences (Milliner AI platform for antibodies, $30M upfront)
WRAP (Whole Room AI Platform): an AI-powered 'digital twin' of a manufacturing space that lets factory staff query and simulate the production environment; described as a pilot. [none]

Allergan Aesthetics (an AbbVie company) uses data science and machine learning on Snowflake with Twilio Segment to generate personalized customer offers and reduce customer acquisition cost. [Snowflake; Twilio Segment]

Adopting Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud for customer engagement across sales, medical affairs and market access in 70+ countries, with plans to enhance the field workforce with AI to give providers information to support patients. [Salesforce (Life Sciences Cloud / Agentforce)]

Predictive pharmacovigilance/safety-signal surveillance model that detects potential new adverse-event signals from post-marketing data using gradient boosting (XGBoost); a proof-of-concept pilot tested on two AbbVie products. [Internally developed (XGBoost)]
deployments_detail.value: Detected one confirmed safety signal 6 months earlier than standard surveillance; sensitivity 50-56%, accuracy 96-98% in pilot
